sloka: एवम् लक्ष्मणम् उक्त्वा तु राघवो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः ।तस्मिन् देशे बहु फले न्यवसत् स सुखम् सुखी ॥३-१५-३०॥
transliteration: evam lakṣmaṇam uktvā tu rāghavo lakṣmivardhanaḥ ।tasmin deśe bahu phale nyavasat sa sukham sukhī ॥3-15-30॥

translations.english: Rama who was an enhancer of fortunes and who had his senses under control said thus to Lakshmana and lived happily there in that place filled with fruits.
